HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Doodle Cricket is an action-packed cricket game where you control the main character to block every ball from the opposing team's pitcher. Score runs and achieve home runs to set new records.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Click on the stick icon next to the character to take your turn.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Pay attention to the properties of each ball path, such as straight ball, fast ball, and spin ball.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Align your character to block the ball and score runs.
